had a cold: I had a cold last week, so I stayed at home and rested.
我上周感冒了,所以待在家里休息。
went camping: We went camping in the mountains and slept in a small tent.
我们去山里野营,睡在一个小帐篷里。
went fishing: My grandfather went fishing by the river every Sunday morning.
我爷爷每周日早上去河边钓鱼。
took pictures: She took pictures of the sunset and sent them to her friends.
她拍了日落的照片,并发给了朋友们。
Labour Day: We had a picnic in the park on Labour Day.
劳动节那天我们在公园里野餐了。
dining hall: Students eat lunch together in the school dining hall at noon.
中午学生们在学校食堂一起吃午饭。
go cycling: It is sunny today, so let's go cycling in the park.
今天天气晴朗,我们去公园骑自行车吧。
look up: You can look up new words in this small dictionary.
你可以用这本小词典查生词。
pencil box: Tom put his new pen into his pencil box carefully.
汤姆小心地把新钢笔放进铅笔盒里。
first floor: Our classroom is on the first floor, next to the library.
我们的教室在一楼,紧挨着图书馆。
second floor: The teachers work in the offices on the second floor.
老师们在二楼的办公室里工作。
teacher's office: Please hand in your homework at the teacher's office after class.
请下课后把作业交到教师办公室。
computer room: We learn how to type in the computer room every Tuesday.
我们每周二在计算机房学习打字。
art room: The children painted beautiful flowers in the art room.
孩子们在美术教室里画了漂亮的花。
music room: The students are singing a song in the music room now.
学生们现在正在音乐教室里唱歌。
next to: The bookshop is next to the bank, near the bus stop.
书店紧挨着银行,就在公交站附近。
English class: We often play word games in our English class.
我们在英语课上经常玩单词游戏。
music class: I like music class because we can sing and play instruments.
我喜欢音乐课,因为我们可以唱歌和演奏乐器。
PE class: Wear your sports shoes because we have a PE class this afternoon.
今天下午有体育课,穿上你的运动鞋。
get up: I usually get up at six thirty and then do morning exercises.
我通常六点半起床,然后做早操。
go to school: The children go to school by bus when it rains.
下雨时孩子们乘公共汽车去上学。
go home: Let's go home together after the football game.
足球比赛结束后我们一起回家吧。
go to bed: Don't go to bed too late before the exam.
考试前不要太晚上床睡觉。
hurry up: Hurry up, or we will miss the early train.
快点,否则我们会错过早班火车。
come on: Come on, we only need five more minutes to finish the work.
加油,我们只需要再花五分钟就能完成这项工作。
just a minute: Just a minute, I am looking for my keys in my bag.
稍等一下,我正在包里找钥匙。
be careful: Be careful when you cross the busy street.
过繁忙的马路时要小心。
New York: My cousin lives in New York and works in a big hospital.
我的表哥住在纽约,在一家大医院工作。
How about going swimming with us this weekend?
这周末和我们一起去游泳怎么样?
green beans: Mom cooked some green beans and eggs for dinner tonight.
妈妈今晚做了一些豆角和鸡蛋当晚饭。
try on: Can I try on these blue shoes before I buy them?
买之前我能试穿一下这双蓝色的鞋吗?
of course: Of course you can borrow my pen if you forget yours.
如果你忘带钢笔,当然可以借我的。
how much: How much did you pay for your new bicycle?
你的新自行车花了多少钱?
teacher's desk: The teacher put our test papers on the teacher's desk.
老师把我们的试卷放在了讲台上。
maths book: I left my maths book at home, so I shared one with Lucy.
我把数学书落在家里了,所以和露西合用一本。
English book: She reads one story from her English book every evening.
她每天晚上读英语书里的一个故事。
Chinese book: Please take out your Chinese book and turn to page ten.
请拿出你们的语文书,翻到第十页。
so much: Thank you so much for helping me clean the classroom.
非常感谢你帮我打扫教室。
living room: My family often watch TV together in the living room in the evening.
晚上我们一家人经常一起在客厅看电视。
help yourself: Help yourself to some fruit on the table, please.
请随便吃桌上的水果吧。
